notes.title: Update v0.6.0
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, soldiers! [/p][p]A fresh update for the demo is here. All core mechanics are now complete — from this point on, we’re focusing on adding new content, polishing the game, fixing bugs, and fine-tuning the balance.[/p][p]Here’s what’s new in this patch:[/p][list][*][p]Added a sleep mechanic for all NPCs. They can get tired and fall asleep on the move, which makes them a vulnerable and easy target.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to talk to all base inhabitants.[/p][/*][*][p]Added detailed descriptions of action success chances.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a difficulty regulator through changing the number of missions per session.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new stealth indicator at night.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an animation for finding new items.[/p][/*][*][p]Added hints for all HUD elements.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved game performance.[/p][/*][/list][p]And most importantly — [b]the very first full quest has been added![/b] Complete it to earn a unique gameplay reward :)[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your feedback, your support, and for sticking with [i]SOG: Vietnam[/i]![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Update v0.5.2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We just pushed a new update that brings an UI overhaul. We've been working on making the interface clearer, more intuitive, and just nicer to look at. Here’s what’s changed:

[list]
[*] Reworked action and item icons.
[*] Redesigned and animated hunger, ammo, and backpack panels.
[*] Added another confirmation prompt before replaying the tutorial.
[*] Improved camera controls.
[*] Fixed the disappearing cursor issue.
[*] Fixed a bunch of bugs and softlocks.
[/list]
We’re still actively working  on the game — adding new features, units, quests, and more to make sure the full release is packed with content.

Thanks so much for playing and supporting SOG: Vietnam!

notes.title: Update v0.4.0
notes.notes:
Hello, players!

We've carefully processed all the feedback and suggestions you've reported to us, and we're ready to release an update that brings the most requested improvements:

[list]
[*] Added pictograms to indicate tile types.
[*] Added ambient sound effects during game session.
[*] Added an "Items" action to the radial menu when selecting a character tile.
[*] Added enemy line-of-sight visibility when hovering over them.
[*] Added item price progression.
[*] Now you can see the success chance (in percentages) for actions that can fail.
[*] Now encountering a map border no longer costs an action point.
[*] Now you can press Space to proceed in various game sequences.
[*] Now you can improve your reputation among civilians using rations only.
[*] Reduced the chance of taking damage when starving.
[*] Fixed multiple bugs and softlock issues.
[/list]

Additionally, we’re pleased to add [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b] localization! (Thank you [url=https://x.com/hbn_loc]Herbert Neto[/url]!)

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Vicious new roguelike is Enter the Gungeon in Vietnam, and you can try it now
notes.notes:
As PCGamesN's resident roguelike player, I'm always on the lookout for what to recommend next. Today it's a game called SOG: Vietnam, which presents itself as a blend of top-down shooters like Enter The Gungeon and tile-based tactics like Into The Breach. So if you're looking for a more methodical roguelike, and one that's filled with plenty of calculated planning, look no further than the game's brand-new Steam demo.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Update v0.3.7
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players!

We've received a lot of valuable feedback and some bug reports. In this patch, we’ve addressed the most critical issues:

[list]
[*] Added additional steps to the tutorial to better explain the base game mechanics.
[*] Added a lock icon in the inventory to clearly indicate locked items. A tooltip will appear if you hover over an item, explaining whether it can be unlocked.
[*] Fixed a softlock where no text was visible when starting the game.
[*] Fixed a softlock where a stealth attack could be triggered on a mountain tile.
[*] Fixed a softlock that occurred after quitting the tutorial and starting a new session.
[*] Fixed a softlock in the tutorial when pressing Escape during certain steps.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Feedback menu opening when pressing Q while typing text in the Goodbye menu.
[/list]

Thank you for playing SOG: Vietnam!
